pattern_classification.semantics: Accepted means current frozen R4 eligibility. Research candidates and rejections are display-only and cannot alter the live watchlist.

universe_intake.authority: rolling observational universe with one-shot frozen promotion and post-freeze prospective evidence; does not rewrite frozen V4.78 historical qualification

family_validation.dependence_caveat: symbol-level sign test; correlated sector/regime membership is not treated as independent trade authority

pattern_classification.semantics: Research classifications are descriptive candidate evidence only. They cannot modify the frozen R4 watchlist or fire a trade.

semantics.gather: never-scanned territory is always consumed before any routine rescan using latest rolling 60d/5m market data
semantics.grade: V11 uses a purged+embargoed chronological split and a predeclared fixed multiplicity family with unobserved slots represented as p=1; arrival order cannot lower the correction burden
semantics.freeze: a pattern that passes its one allowed promotion test is timestamped and frozen before any prospective evidence can count
semantics.prospective: only V11-frozen rules count; confirmation uses the first 20 distinct trading days after freeze with a fixed prospective multiplicity family
semantics.family_validation: cross-symbol recurrence receives an explicit symbol-level family sign test with fixed-family BY; it is corroboration only because sector/regime dependence can remain
semantics.paper_handoff: confirmed prospective rules from core listed symbols can be written as PAPER_CANDIDATE_ONLY; GitHub-only expansion symbols remain observation-only until independent core-listing verification
semantics.add: routine official listing refresh adds newly observed core-listed symbols immediately
semantics.expand: when the unseen queue reaches zero, Argus attempts GitHub-backed U.S.-listed plus OTC discovery before spending capacity on rescans; GitHub-only symbols remain observation-only until independent core verification
semantics.loop: priority is unseen current-census symbols -> expansion frontier -> unseen expansion symbols -> oldest maintenance rescan only when no new territory is available
semantics.context_binding: each scan records the market-context hash current when the symbol was observed
